The Bright Side:
Children gain helpful built-in time limits and night modes across major platforms.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confuses WHAT (corporate financial settlements) with WHO (protecting children's actual mental health).

By treating safety as a legal settlement rather than a structural duty, the platform shields its core profit model behind cosmetic restrictions.

The Unavoidable Lie: Paying a fine equates to solving the design flaw.
